desc: Co-op: player 2's partner hops and lands back to normal. Rogueport's plaza (Mario put at 240 0 20), Goombella: player 2 takes her with the stick, hops on the spot on flat ground, hops while walking, then hops twice while Mario walks away (his walk under her hop). Each hop lands ('hop landed') and she stands or walks again, never left in the jump pose. Shots: flat (standing after the first hop), walking (after the walking hop), mario_moves (after the hops while Mario walked)
log_must: player 2's character: hop landed at .* pose PKR_\w+ \(the jump's PKR_J
